primary_operating_point: maximum validation F1; attack labels used to calibrate all thresholds
study_status: exploratory documented subset; subset and method fixed before initial CTT test evaluation
champion_selection: highest validation F1, never test F1
labeling: author-provided binary frame labels; window positive if any attack frame
inference_timing: feature extraction excluded; offline CPU scoring; not a real-time guarantee

dataset_provenance.selection: set_01: all training files; first 1 test capture(s) per attack family per official folder, lexicographic order; selection fixed before test evaluation
dataset_provenance.integrity: ZIP member CRC32 checked on download; SHA256 recorded; entire-archive MD5 not verified for partial transfer
